thread.title: Details Emerge About Shooter's Mental Health and Background
thread.title_full: Details Emerge About Shooter's Mental Health and Background

author: The Associated Press
title: Details Emerge About Shooter's Mental Health and Background
text:
• Shane Tamura, 27, killed four people in a shooting in New York City before taking his own life.
• Tamura had a documented history of mental health issues, including depression and chronic migraines.
• He threatened to kill himself during a 911 call made by his mother on September 12, 2022.
• Tamura's mother reported he was under a doctor's care and was taking sleeping pills and smoking marijuana.
• He accused the NFL of hiding dangers related to brain injuries from contact sports.
• Tamura played high school football in Southern California but did not play professionally.
• He was committed to a hospital for a mental health crisis in 2024 after expressing suicidal thoughts.
• Tamura worked in the surveillance department at Horseshoe Las Vegas until shortly before the shooting.
• He purchased the rifle used in the shooting and the car he drove from his supervisor at the casino.
• New York City detectives found a tripod for the rifle, a box for a revolver, and ammunition in Tamura's locker.
• His psychiatric history did not legally prevent him from purchasing firearms unless an extreme risk protection order was sought.
• A new state law effective this month allows officers to confiscate firearms from individuals on a mental health crisis hold.
• Tamura had previous run-ins with the law, including an arrest for trespassing at a casino in 2023.
